mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_status_outbox( event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, created_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, 0, 0, NOW(3) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, lease_recovery_count, confirm_writeback_count, next_retry_at, sending_at, lease_token, last_error, created_at, sent_at FROM video_status_outbox WHERE status = 0 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE video_status_outbox SET status = 2, sent_at = #{sentAt}, sending_at = NULL, lease_token = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 1 AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}

UPDATE video_status_outbox SET status = CASE WHEN confirm_writeback_count + 1 >= 10 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN confirm_writeback_count + 1 >= 10 THEN NULL ELSE #{nextRetryAt} END, sending_at = NULL, lease_token = NULL, last_error = CASE WHEN confirm_writeback_count + 1 >= 10 THEN 'confirm writeback budget exhausted' ELSE #{lastError} END, confirm_writeback_count = confirm_writeback_count + 1 WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 1 AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}

UPDATE video_status_outbox SET status = 3, next_retry_at = NULL, sending_at = NULL, lease_token = NULL, last_error = 'confirm writeback budget exhausted', confirm_writeback_count = confirm_writeback_count + 1 WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 1 AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}

UPDATE video_status_outbox SET status = CASE WHEN lease_recovery_count + 1 >= 10 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN lease_recovery_count + 1 >= 10 THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, 1, NOW(3)) END, sending_at = NULL, lease_token = NULL, last_error = CASE WHEN lease_recovery_count + 1 >= 10 THEN 'lease recovery budget exhausted' ELSE '发送租约超时，已自动恢复（不计入发布重试）' END, lease_recovery_count = lease_recovery_count + 1 WHERE status = 1 AND sending_at < #{expiredBefore} ORDER BY sending_at, id LIMIT 1000
